forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: No problem, an admin will reset it for you. It only takes a minute.
steps: Enter your mobile number or 8-digit Student ID below.
Tap “WhatsApp the admin”, a message with your details opens.
The admin sets a temporary password and sends it to you. Sign in and change it from My Profile.
forgot.identifierHint: Added to the message so the admin can find your account.
forgot.staffNote: Admins and staff: ask the owner to reset your password from the Owner Console.
